py: pr1 i · zy = BinProductPr2 C Pxy
c: C

g: C ⟦ c, y ⟧
co: ∑ k : C ⟦ c, z ⟧, k · zx = f × k · zy = g
transportf
  (λ x0 : C ⟦ c, z ⟧, x0 · zx = f × x0 · zy = g)
  (! z_iso_inv_to_right c Pxy z
       (BinProductArrow C Pxy f g)
       (z_iso_inv (BinProductArrow C Pxy zx zy,, i))
       (pr1 co)
       (! BinProductArrowUnique C x y Pxy c f g
            (pr1 co
             · inv_from_z_iso
                 (z_iso_inv
                    (BinProductArrow C Pxy zx zy,, i)))
            (assoc' (pr1 co)
               (inv_from_z_iso
                  (z_iso_inv
                     (BinProductArrow C Pxy zx zy,, i)))
               (BinProductPr1 C Pxy) @
             maponpaths (compose (pr1 co))
               (BinProductPr1Commutes C x y Pxy z zx
                  zy) @ pr12 co)
            (assoc' (pr1 co)
               (inv_from_z_iso
                  (z_iso_inv
                     (BinProductArrow C Pxy zx zy,, i)))
               (BinProductPr2 C Pxy) @
             maponpaths (compose (pr1 co))
               (BinProductPr2Commutes C x y Pxy z zx
                  zy) @ pr22 co))) (pr2 co) =
pr2
  (BinProductArrow C Pxy f g · pr1 i,,
   (assoc' (BinProductArrow C Pxy f g) (pr1 i) zx @
    maponpaths (compose (BinProductArrow C Pxy f g))
      px @ BinProductPr1Commutes C x y Pxy c f g),,
   assoc' (BinProductArrow C Pxy f g) (pr1 i) zy @
   maponpaths (compose (BinProductArrow C Pxy f g)) py @
   BinProductPr2Commutes C x y Pxy c f g)
 use total2_paths_f ; apply homset_property.
  Defined.

             (C : category) (BP : BinProducts C) (pcp : ∏ p : hProp, Coproducts p C)
               : UU
    := ∏ p : hProp, ∏ x y : C, is_z_isomorphism (coproducts_commute_binproducts_mor BP (pcp p) x y).

             (H
                (BinProduct_of_functors_ob C D BPD F G
                   x))
             (# H (pr121 (BPD (F x) (G x)) · # F f))
             (# H (pr221 (BPD (F x) (G x)) · # G f))
             (# H
                (BinProduct_of_functors_mor C D BPD F
                   G x x' f))
             (! functor_comp H
                  (BinProduct_of_functors_mor C D BPD
                     F G x x' f)
                  (pr121 (BPD (F x') (G x'))) @
              maponpaths # H
                (BinProductPr1Commutes D (F x') (G x')
                   (BPD (F x') (G x'))
                   (BPD (F x) (G x))
                   (pr121 (BPD (F x) (G x)) · # F f)
                   (BinProductPr2 D (BPD (F x) (G x))
                    · # G f)))
             (! functor_comp H
                  (BinProduct_of_functors_mor C D BPD
                     F G x x' f)
                  (pr221 (BPD (F x') (G x'))) @
              maponpaths # H
                (BinProductPr2Commutes D (F x') (G x')
                   (BPD (F x') (G x'))
                   (BPD (F x) (G x))
                   (BinProductPr1 D (BPD (F x) (G x))
                    · # F f)
                   (pr221 (BPD (F x) (G x)) · # G f))) @
           ! BinProductArrowUnique E (H (F x'))
               (H (G x')) (P x')
               (H
                  (BinProduct_of_functors_ob C D BPD F
                     G x))
               (# H (pr121 (BPD (F x) (G x)) · # F f))
               (# H (pr221 (BPD (F x) (G x)) · # G f))
               (BinProductArrow E
                  (BPE (H (F x')) (H (G x')))
                  (# H (pr121 (BPD (F x) (G x)))
                   · # H (# F f))
                  (# H (pr221 (BPD (F x) (G x)))
                   · # H (# G f))
                · BinProductArrow E (P x')
                    (BinProductPr1 E
                       (BPE (H (F x')) (H (G x'))))
                    (BinProductPr2 E
                       (BPE (H (F x')) (H (G x')))))
               (assoc'
                  (BinProductArrow E
                     (BPE (H (F x')) (H (G x')))
                     (# H (pr121 (BPD (F x) (G x)))
                      · # H (# F f))
                     (# H (pr221 (BPD (F x) (G x)))
                      · # H (# G f)))
                  (BinProductArrow E (P x')
                     (BinProductPr1 E
                        (BPE (H (F x')) (H (G x'))))
                     (BinProductPr2 E
                        (BPE (H (F x')) (H (G x')))))
                  (BinProductPr1 E (P x')) @
                maponpaths
                  (compose
                     (BinProductArrow E
                        (BPE (H (...)) (H (...)))
                        (# H (pr121 (...))
                         · # H (# F f))
                        (# H (pr221 (...))
                         · # H (# G f))))
                  (BinProductPr1Commutes E (H (F x'))
                     (H (G x')) (P x')
                     (BPE (H (F x')) (H (G x')))
                     (BinProductPr1 E
                        (BPE (H (...)) (H (...))))
                     (BinProductPr2 E
                        (BPE (H (...)) (H (...))))) @
                BinProductPr1Commutes E (H (F x'))
                  (H (G x'))
                  (BPE (H (F x')) (H (G x')))
                  (H (pr11 (BPD (F x) (G x))))
                  (# H (pr121 (BPD (F x) (G x)))
                   · # H (# F f))
                  (# H (pr221 (BPD (F x) (G x)))
                   · # H (# G f)) @
                ! functor_comp H
                    (pr121 (BPD (F x) (G x))) (# F f))
               (assoc'
                  (BinProductArrow E
                     (BPE (H (F x')) (H (G x')))
                     (# H (pr121 (BPD (F x) (G x)))
                      · # H (# F f))
                     (# H (pr221 (BPD (F x) (G x)))
                      · # H (# G f)))
                  (BinProductArrow E (P x')
                     (BinProductPr1 E
                        (BPE (H (F x')) (H (G x'))))
                     (BinProductPr2 E
                        (BPE (H (F x')) (H (G x')))))
                  (BinProductPr2 E (P x')) @
                maponpaths
                  (compose
                     (BinProductArrow E
                        (BPE (H (...)) (H (...)))
                        (# H (pr121 (...))
                         · # H (# F f))
                        (# H (pr221 (...))
                         · # H (# G f))))
                  (BinProductPr2Commutes E (H (F x'))
                     (H (G x')) (P x')
                     (BPE (H (F x')) (H (G x')))
                     (BinProductPr1 E
                        (BPE (H (...)) (H (...))))
                     (BinProductPr2 E
                        (BPE (H (...)) (H (...))))) @
                BinProductPr2Commutes E (H (F x'))
                  (H (G x'))
                  (BPE (H (F x')) (H (G x')))
                  (H (pr11 (BPD (F x) (G x))))
                  (# H (pr121 (BPD (F x) (G x)))
                   · # H (# F f))
                  (# H (pr221 (BPD (F x) (G x)))
                   · # H (# G f)) @
                ! functor_comp H
                    (pr221 (BPD (F x) (G x))) (# G f))
           :
           # (BinProduct_of_functors BPD F G ∙ H) f =
           BinProductArrow E
             (BPE ((F ∙ H) x') ((G ∙ H) x'))
             (BinProductPr1 E (P x) · # (F ∙ H) f)
             (BinProductPr2 E (P x) · # (G ∙ H) f)
           · inv_from_z_iso (i x')) @
          maponpaths_2 compose
            (! postcompWithBinProductArrow E
                 (BPE ((F ∙ H) x') ((G ∙ H) x'))
                 (BPE ((F ∙ H) x) ((G ∙ H) x))
                 (# (F ∙ H) f) (# (G ∙ H) f)
                 (BinProductPr1 E (P x))
                 (BinProductPr2 E (P x)))
            (inv_from_z_iso (i x'))))
      :
      is_nat_trans
        (BinProduct_of_functors BPD F G ∙ H)
        (BinProduct_of_functors BPE (F ∙ H) (G ∙ H))
        ((λ c : C, let X := pr1 (i c) in X)
         :
         nat_trans_data
           (BinProduct_of_functors BPD F G ∙ H)
           (BinProduct_of_functors BPE (F ∙ H) (G ∙ H)))))

        ((BinProductArrowUnique E (H (F x'))

            (# H (pr121 (BPD (F x) (G x)) · # F f))

            (! functor_comp H

                    G x x' f)

                  (BPD (F x') (G x'))
                  (BPD (F x) (G x))
                  (pr121 (BPD (F x) (G x)) · # F f)

            (! functor_comp H

                   · # F f)

          ! BinProductArrowUnique E (H (F x'))

              (H

                    G x))
              (# H (pr121 (BPD (F x) (G x)) · # F f))
              (# H (pr221 (BPD (F x) (G x)) · # G f))
              (BinProductArrow E

               (BinProductArrow D Pc
                  (BinProductPr1 D (BP (F1 c) (F2 c)))
                  (BinProductPr2 D (BP (F1 c) (F2 c)))
                · P1 c))
            (BinProductPr2Commutes D (pr1 F1 c)
               (pr1 F2 c) Pc
               (functor_precat_binproduct_cone C D BP
                  F1 F2 c)
               (BinProductPr1 D (BP (F1 c) (F2 c)))
               (BinProductPr2 D (BP (F1 c) (F2 c)))) @
          maponpaths_2
            (BinProductArrow D (BP (F1 c) (F2 c)))
            (BinProductPr1Commutes D (pr1 F1 c)
               (pr1 F2 c) Pc
               (functor_precat_binproduct_cone C D BP
                  F1 F2 c)
               (BinProductPr1 D (BP (F1 c) (F2 c)))
               (BinProductPr2 D (BP (F1 c) (F2 c))))
            (BinProductPr2 D (BP (F1 c) (F2 c))) @
          ! BinProductArrowId (BP (F1 c) (F2 c)))))
 · P2) c =
BinProductPr2 [C, D]
  (functor_precat_binproduct_cone C D BP F1 F2) c

        apply (BinProductPr2Commutes D _ _ Pc).
  Defined.

P_prod: isBinProduct [C, D] F1 F2 P P1 P2
c: C

  (pr1 P2 c)

    exact (isBinProduct_to_objectwise P_prod BPD c).
  Defined.

  Definition BinProductOfArrows_is_z_iso
        {C : category}
        {a b : C} (Pab : BinProduct C a b)
        {c d : C} (Pcd : BinProduct C c d)
        (f : C ⟦ a, c ⟧) (g : C ⟦ b, d ⟧)
    : is_z_isomorphism f
      -> is_z_isomorphism g
      -> is_z_isomorphism (BinProductOfArrows C Pcd Pab f g)
    := λ pf pg, make_is_z_isomorphism _ _ (binproduct_of_z_iso_inv Pab Pcd (_,,pf) (_,,pg)).

C, D: category
F1, F2, G1, G2: C ⟶ D
BP: BinProducts D
α1: nat_z_iso F1 G1
α2: nat_z_iso F2 G2
is_nat_z_iso
  (make_nat_trans (BinProduct_of_functors BP F1 F2)
     (BinProduct_of_functors BP G1 G2)
     ((λ c : C,
       BinProductOfArrows D (BP (G1 c) (G2 c))
         (BP (F1 c) (F2 c))
         (let X := pr1 α1 in let X0 := pr1 X in X0 c)
         (let X := pr1 α2 in let X0 := pr1 X in X0 c))
      :
      nat_trans_data (BinProduct_of_functors BP F1 F2)
        (BinProduct_of_functors BP G1 G2))
     ((λ (x y : C) (f : C ⟦ x, y ⟧),
       postcompWithBinProductArrow D
         (BP (G1 y) (G2 y)) (BP (F1 y) (F2 y))
         (let X := pr1 α1 in let X0 := pr1 X in X0 y)
         (let X := pr1 α2 in let X0 := pr1 X in X0 y)
         (BinProductPr1 D (BP (F1 x) (F2 x)) · # F1 f)
         (BinProductPr2 D (BP (F1 x) (F2 x)) · # F2 f) @
       (maponpaths_2
          (BinProductArrow D (BP (G1 y) (G2 y)))
          (assoc' (BinProductPr1 D (BP (F1 x) (F2 x)))
             (# F1 f)
             (let X := pr1 α1 in
              let X0 := pr1 X in X0 y))
          (BinProductPr2 D (BP (F1 x) (F2 x)) · # F2 f
           · (let X := pr1 α2 in
              let X0 := pr1 X in X0 y)) @
        maponpaths_2
          (BinProductArrow D (BP (G1 y) (G2 y)))
          (maponpaths
             (compose
                (BinProductPr1 D (BP (F1 x) (F2 x))))
             ((pr21 α1) x y f))
          (BinProductPr2 D (BP (F1 x) (F2 x)) · # F2 f
           · (let X := pr1 α2 in
              let X0 := pr1 X in X0 y)) @
        maponpaths
          (BinProductArrow D (BP (G1 y) (G2 y))
             (BinProductPr1 D (BP (F1 x) (F2 x))
              · ((let X := pr1 α1 in
                  let X0 := pr1 X in X0 x) · # G1 f)))
          (assoc' (BinProductPr2 D (BP (F1 x) (F2 x)))
             (# F2 f)
             (let X := pr1 α2 in
              let X0 := pr1 X in X0 y) @
           maponpaths
             (compose
                (BinProductPr2 D (BP (F1 x) (F2 x))))
             ((pr21 α2) x y f) @
           assoc (BinProductPr2 D (BP (F1 x) (F2 x)))
             (let X := pr1 α2 in
              let X0 := pr1 X in X0 x) (# G2 f)) @
        maponpaths_2
          (BinProductArrow D (BP (G1 y) (G2 y)))
          (assoc (BinProductPr1 D (BP (F1 x) (F2 x)))
             (let X := pr1 α1 in
              let X0 := pr1 X in X0 x) (# G1 f))
          (BinProductPr2 D (BP (F1 x) (F2 x))
           · (let X := pr1 α2 in
              let X0 := pr1 X in X0 x) · # G2 f)) @
       ! postcompWithBinProductArrow D
           (BP (G1 y) (G2 y)) (BP (G1 x) (G2 x))
           (# G1 f) (# G2 f)
           (BinProductPr1 D (BP (F1 x) (F2 x))
            · (let X := pr1 α1 in
               let X0 := pr1 X in X0 x))
           (BinProductPr2 D (BP (F1 x) (F2 x))
            · (let X := pr1 α2 in
               let X0 := pr1 X in X0 x)))
      :
      is_nat_trans (BinProduct_of_functors BP F1 F2)
        (BinProduct_of_functors BP G1 G2)
        ((λ c : C,
          BinProductOfArrows D (BP (G1 c) (G2 c))
            (BP (F1 c) (F2 c))
            (let X := pr1 α1 in
             let X0 := pr1 X in X0 c)
            (let X := pr1 α2 in
             let X0 := pr1 X in X0 c))
         :
         nat_trans_data
           (BinProduct_of_functors BP F1 F2)
           (BinProduct_of_functors BP G1 G2))))
 
C, D: category
F1, F2, G1, G2: C ⟶ D
BP: BinProducts D
α1: nat_z_iso F1 G1
α2: nat_z_iso F2 G2
c: C
is_z_isomorphism
  (make_nat_trans (BinProduct_of_functors BP F1 F2)
     (BinProduct_of_functors BP G1 G2)
     (λ c : C,
      BinProductOfArrows D (BP (G1 c) (G2 c))
        (BP (F1 c) (F2 c))
        (let X := pr1 α1 in let X0 := pr1 X in X0 c)
        (let X := pr1 α2 in let X0 := pr1 X in X0 c))
     (λ (x y : C) (f : C ⟦ x, y ⟧),
      postcompWithBinProductArrow D (BP (G1 y) (G2 y))
        (BP (F1 y) (F2 y))
        (let X := pr1 α1 in let X0 := pr1 X in X0 y)
        (let X := pr1 α2 in let X0 := pr1 X in X0 y)
        (BinProductPr1 D (BP (F1 x) (F2 x)) · # F1 f)
        (BinProductPr2 D (BP (F1 x) (F2 x)) · # F2 f) @
      (maponpaths_2
         (BinProductArrow D (BP (G1 y) (G2 y)))
         (assoc' (BinProductPr1 D (BP (F1 x) (F2 x)))
            (# F1 f)
            (let X := pr1 α1 in
             let X0 := pr1 X in X0 y))
         (BinProductPr2 D (BP (F1 x) (F2 x)) · # F2 f
          · (let X := pr1 α2 in
             let X0 := pr1 X in X0 y)) @
       maponpaths_2
         (BinProductArrow D (BP (G1 y) (G2 y)))
         (maponpaths
            (compose
               (BinProductPr1 D (BP (F1 x) (F2 x))))
            ((pr21 α1) x y f))
         (BinProductPr2 D (BP (F1 x) (F2 x)) · # F2 f
          · (let X := pr1 α2 in
             let X0 := pr1 X in X0 y)) @
       maponpaths
         (BinProductArrow D (BP (G1 y) (G2 y))
            (BinProductPr1 D (BP (F1 x) (F2 x))
             · ((let X := pr1 α1 in
                 let X0 := pr1 X in X0 x) · # G1 f)))
         (assoc' (BinProductPr2 D (BP (F1 x) (F2 x)))
            (# F2 f)
            (let X := pr1 α2 in
             let X0 := pr1 X in X0 y) @
          maponpaths
            (compose
               (BinProductPr2 D (BP (F1 x) (F2 x))))
            ((pr21 α2) x y f) @
          assoc (BinProductPr2 D (BP (F1 x) (F2 x)))
            (let X := pr1 α2 in
             let X0 := pr1 X in X0 x) (# G2 f)) @
       maponpaths_2
         (BinProductArrow D (BP (G1 y) (G2 y)))
         (assoc (BinProductPr1 D (BP (F1 x) (F2 x)))
            (let X := pr1 α1 in
             let X0 := pr1 X in X0 x) (# G1 f))
         (BinProductPr2 D (BP (F1 x) (F2 x))
          · (let X := pr1 α2 in
             let X0 := pr1 X in X0 x) · # G2 f)) @
      ! postcompWithBinProductArrow D
          (BP (G1 y) (G2 y)) (BP (G1 x) (G2 x))
          (# G1 f) (# G2 f)
          (BinProductPr1 D (BP (F1 x) (F2 x))
           · (let X := pr1 α1 in
              let X0 := pr1 X in X0 x))
          (BinProductPr2 D (BP (F1 x) (F2 x))
           · (let X := pr1 α2 in
              let X0 := pr1 X in X0 x))) c)

α1: nat_z_iso F1 G1
α2: nat_z_iso F2 G2
c: C
is_z_isomorphism
  (let X := pr1 α1 in let X0 := pr1 X in X0 c)

  (let X := pr1 α2 in let X0 := pr1 X in X0 c)

  Let TsortToCC : Terminal [sortToC,C] := SortIndexing.TsortToCC sort Hsort _ TC.
